title: CLI Command Failure After Version Update to 0.2.119
body:
**Bug Description**
After updating to version 0.2.119, the `claude` CLI command stopped working. None of the commands (e.g., claude --version, claude --help, etc.) are functioning.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: Apple_Terminal
- Version: 0.2.118 (Downgrade from 0.2.119)
- Feedback ID: eb5c4198-78ba-477d-9681-63cff4f9571d

**Errors**
